body: Models with this special rule treat terrain designated as a `water feature' as Open Ground. In addition, as long as at least 50% of the models in the unit are within a `water feature' they benefit from partial cover. `Water features' might include shallow streams or fords, swampy ground, fast flowing rivers, ponds or lakes, and players should agree prior to the game if any terrain is a water feature.
Each war beast in a unit with this special rule is accompanied by a number of models representing its handlers. As long as any handlers remain, the war beast ignores the Undisciplined special rule.
During deployment, position these models anywhere within 1" of the war beasts. If the handlers are found to be blocking movement or line of sight, simply move them aside.

In combat, each handler adds its attacks to those of the war beasts. If there are multiple war beasts in combat, the additional attacks from the handlers are distributed as evenly as possible among the war beasts.

If a war beast suffers an unsaved wound from any source, roll a D6. On a roll of 1-4 a war beast loses a Wound, but on a roll of 5+ one of the handlers is removed instead. If all war beasts are removed from play, so are the handlers.

When an enemy unit shoots at a Salamander or Razordon Pack that contains one or more Skink Handlers, the enemy player must roll a D6 for each successful roll To Hit before making any rolls To Wound. On a roll of 1-4, the hit is inflicted upon a Salamander or Razordon. On a roll of 5+, the hit is inflicted upon a Skink Handler.

A model with this special rule (but not its mount) generates one additional Attack on any natural roll of a 6 made when rolling To Hit in close combat. Roll To Hit and To Wound for this additional Attack as normal. Additional Attacks generated by this special rule cannot themselves generate further Attacks.

Blessed by Itzl, skinks are cunning riders, and let their ferocious mounts do the brunt of the fighting Attacks made against this unit are resolved against the weapon skill of the rider, the crew, or monster, whichever is higher.
